exposure: Maximum Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score
cohort: The study included 100 women aged 18 years or more, between 28 weeks of gestation and up to six weeks post-partum, admitted to ICU from an obstetric unit with severe obstetrical or non-obstetrical complications and staying over 48 hours.
finding: The SOFA score demonstrated good prognostic power in predicting outcomes for obstetric patients with severe illness admitted to the ICU, with higher scores significantly correlating with increased mortality.
